title: v1.0 - Full Admin Control

items: GiraRepository - CRUD with filtering and date range queries
UserRepository - User management with role filtering
AuditService - Structured logging for all admin actions
main.py - Updated with admin router and audit middleware
admin/admin_layout.tsx - Master layout with responsive drawer (T071)
admin/dashboard.tsx - KPI cards and analytics charts (T072)
admin/giras.tsx - Gira CRUD table with edit/delete modals (T073)
admin/tickets.tsx - Tickets list with pagination and bulk selection (T074)
admin/config.tsx - Branding and feature flag configuration (T075)
admin/audit_trail.tsx - Audit log viewer with filtering (T076)

coverage: CRUD Operations (8 tests) - Create, read, update, delete for giras
Tickets Operations (8 tests) - Listing, filtering, bulk operations
Admin Config (5 tests) - Branding, email, feature flags
Audit Trail (6 tests) - Query filtering, immutability verification
Analytics (5 tests) - Period selection, aggregations, filtering
User Management (8 tests) - User CRUD, role management, deactivation
Health Checks (1 test) - Service status verification
Multi-Tenant Isolation (2 tests) - Data segregation verification
Audit Logging (2 tests) - Action logging verification

key_features.rbac: Role-based access control - SUPER_ADMIN, ADMIN, OPERATOR roles with endpoint-level enforcement
key_features.audit_trail: Immutable audit trail - All admin operations automatically logged with actor, action, resource, metadata
key_features.analytics: SQL aggregations - COUNT, SUM, AVG queries for daily distributions, peak hours, usage rates
key_features.bulk_operations: Bulk operations - Dry-run validation before execution, transaction support, error handling
key_features.multi_tenant: Multi-tenant isolation - All queries filtered by tenant_id at repository level
key_features.soft_delete: Soft delete support - Deleted records marked but retained for audit compliance
key_features.email_failover: Email service failover - Primary (Brevo) with Resend fallback
key_features.frontend_ui: Material-UI admin dashboard - DataGrid tables, modals, charts, color pickers, feature toggles

architecture_patterns: Dry-run validation pattern for bulk operations
database_schema_updates: Tenant model updated with one-to-one config relationship
DateTime import fixed in Ticket model
All models include proper cascade and foreign key relationships

bulk_operation_response.errors: Array of error messages if any
bulk_operation_response.dry_run: Boolean indicating if this was validation only

audit_log_response.action: Action type (CREATE, UPDATE, DELETE, BULK, LOGIN, etc)

error_handling.403: Forbidden - Insufficient permissions for admin operations
error_handling.404: Not Found - Resource not found or inaccessible
error_handling.409: Conflict - Duplicate email, invalid state transition
error_handling.500: Server Error - Unexpected error with audit logging

compliance_features: Immutable audit trail for LGPD compliance
Automatic action logging with actor identification
Request IP logging for security audit
performance_optimizations: Batch bulk operations with transaction support
Aggregation queries at database level (not application)
Pagination support for large result sets

testing_coverage.unit_tests: API endpoint tests with permission validation
testing_coverage.integration_tests: Multi-tenant isolation, audit logging, bulk operations
testing_coverage.fixtures: Test users (admin, operator), test data (giras, tickets)

next_phase: Phase 5 - UI/UX refinement and branding customization
